stories.title: Trump says Bombardier cannot sell in US unless it builds there
stories.summary: President Trump said Canada's Bombardier cannot sell aircraft in the US unless it builds them there. The statement raises the stakes for Bombardier's US business and for US-Canada trade relations. No detail on enforcement or timing was given.
stories.whyItMatters: A US demand to build locally could hit Bombardier's US sales and add friction to trade ties with Canada.
whatToWatch: Any formal US trade action or tariff
questions: What US policy or authority would enforce this?
Would Bombardier build a US plant, or exit the US market?
